verdict.rationale: Relay documents outgoing international wires that can send same-day, with a delivery estimate shown before confirming. A community review calls the international transfer system easy to use, with straightforward pricing of $10 per outgoing transaction, waived on Relay Pro. Nothing shows that payments can be sent in the recipient's local currency rather than USD, and there is no FX rate or markup disclosure. Missing for 10: evidence of local-currency (non-USD) sending, FX rate/markup transparency, first-party fee documentation for international wires.
